meta.name: handoff
meta.description: Generate a HANDOFF.md that captures goal, current state, files touched, failed attempts, and next steps — so a fresh Claude session can continue exactly where this one left off. Use when sessions are getting long, Claude keeps retrying the same broken solution, or the user wants to step away and resume later.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把当前目标、进度和卡点写成交接文档,让下一次会话直接接着干
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果对话越拖越长、想中途收工再回来继续同一件事。
copy.tagline_en: Capture goals, progress, and blockers into a handoff doc so the next session continues.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a session is dragging on and you want to pause and pick it up later.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在项目根目录写出一份 HANDOFF.md,记录目标、当前状态、涉及的文件、试过且失败的方案及原因、当前判断和下一步。新会话读它就能接着做,不用带着旧上下文重来。
howto.when: 会话变长、Claude 反复重试同一个失败方案、你想先离开稍后继续、或 /compact 后仍没有方向时会用;你说 “handoff” 等说法也会触发。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude writes a HANDOFF.md in the project root covering the goal, current state, files touched, failed attempts and why they failed, current theory and next steps, so a fresh session can continue the work.
howto.when_en: Use when a session gets long, Claude keeps retrying the same failing fix, you want to step away and resume later, or you say "handoff" or "write a handoff doc".

say_en.text: Write a handoff doc so I can continue in a new session
say_en.note: Creates HANDOFF.md in the project root
